calculation.description: Ranks 20-day trend returns by short-horizon volatility, with a bounded reward when 20-day volatility is compressed relative to its 60-day baseline. Intended for 10-trading-day forward returns.

validation.regime_notes: Positive over 2020-2022 (0.056595), 2023-2024 (0.005975), 2025-2026 (0.039538), and 2027-2028 (0.016598); negative in the partial 2029 window (-0.060701, 128 observations), indicating current drift risk.
